body.name: Path-transshipment dual
body.construction: Let \(\bar u_j=[u_{a,z}(r_j)-Mh^\beta]_+\). Define \(\mathcal D_h(w,\bar u)\) as all nonnegative \(d_h=(\lambda^+,\lambda^-,g,d)\) with \(\lambda_j^+,\lambda_j^-\) for \(j=0,\ldots,m\) and \(g_j,d_j\) for \(j=0,\ldots,m-1\) satisfying \(\lambda_j^+-\lambda_j^-+g_{j-1}-g_j+d_j-d_{j-1}=w_j\), with \(g_{-1}=g_m=d_{-1}=d_m=0\). Its cost is \(\sum_{j=0}^{m}\bar u_j\lambda_j^+ +Lh\sum_{j=0}^{m-1}g_j\).
